relations.name: workspace_facility
relations.meaning: An NPDES-permitted facility listed in the workspace source manifest.
relations.grounding_contract: Each tuple is grounded to sources/source_manifest.json facility entry by permit number.
relations.construction_rule: C1: Emit one referent per manifest facility key; copy permit number and display name from manifest.

relations.name: permit_discharge_feature
relations.meaning: A permit-authorized discharge or monitoring feature (outfall, toxicity outfall, etc.) as reported in structured extracts.
relations.grounding_contract: Each tuple cites the structured CSV row(s) where PERM_FEATURE_ID and PERM_FEATURE_NMBR appear.
relations.construction_rule: C1: Canonicalize one feature referent per distinct (permit_number, PERM_FEATURE_ID) from permit_limits.csv and dmr_measurements.csv.

relations.name: monitored_parameter
relations.meaning: A pollutant or monitoring parameter code and description as compiled from permit limit and DMR extracts.
relations.grounding_contract: Each tuple is grounded to at least one structured CSV row sharing the PARAMETER_CODE.
relations.construction_rule: C1: One parameter referent per distinct PARAMETER_CODE observed in structured sources.

relations.name: monitoring_period
relations.meaning: A DMR monitoring period identified by its period-end date and facility context.
relations.grounding_contract: Each tuple cites MONITORING_PERIOD_END_DATE (and facility) from dmr_measurements.csv or equivalent structured row.
relations.construction_rule: C1: One period referent per distinct (facility, MONITORING_PERIOD_END_DATE) in DMR extracts; normalize dates to ISO-8601.

relations.name: compiled_limit_value
relations.meaning: One permit limit value row from the compiled limit schedule, including numeric threshold, units, statistical base, type code, and schedule metadata.
relations.grounding_contract: Each tuple is grounded to a permit_limits.csv row keyed by LIMIT_VALUE_ID (or equivalent composite key).
relations.construction_rule: C1: Parse permit_limits.csv; join foreign keys to facility, feature, and parameter referents; preserve blank numeric fields as null REAL.

relations.name: compiled_dmr_measurement

roles.name: measurement
roles.semantic_identity: reported measurement reference or value summary

roles.name: nodi_code
roles.semantic_identity: observed result form (NODI code, blank, qualifier-only, absent submission, etc.)

relations.meaning: A reported DMR measurement value (numeric, qualified, or NODI-coded) as compiled from structured DMR extracts.
relations.grounding_contract: Each tuple cites dmr_measurements.csv by DMR_VALUE_ID (or row fingerprint when ID absent).
relations.construction_rule: C1: Parse dmr_measurements.csv; link facility, feature, parameter, and period referents; retain NODI and qualifier fields verbatim.

relations.name: source_document_anchor
relations.meaning: A permit or supporting PDF acquired for a facility, anchored by path and content hash.
relations.grounding_contract: Each tuple is grounded to sources/source_manifest.json permit_files entry.
relations.construction_rule: C1: Emit one document referent per manifest permit_files record.

relations.name: monitoring_requirement_schedule

roles.name: requirement
roles.semantic_identity: requirement identification (parameter, feature, frequency, limit set, or permit condition anchor)

relations.meaning: A monitoring obligation tuple extracted from compiled permit limit schedules, including frequency and any schedule-stated condition anchor text.
relations.grounding_contract: Each tuple cites the permit_limits.csv row(s) that define the monitoring frequency and parameter scope.
relations.construction_rule: C1: Derive requirement referents from distinct schedule tuples (facility, feature, parameter, limit_set, frequency, effective window); copy DMR_COMMENT_TEXT as condition_anchor_text when present.

relations.name: period_in_fy2025
relations.meaning: Whether a monitoring period's end date falls within Federal FY2025 (2024-10-01 through 2025-09-30 inclusive).
relations.grounding_contract: Derivation receipt over monitoring_period with explicit FY2025 boundary from 00_intention_contract.json.
relations.construction_rule: C4: SQL over monitoring_period.period_end_date against contract period bounds.

relations.name: dmr_in_fy2025_scope

roles.name: measurement
roles.semantic_identity: reported measurement reference or value summary

relations.meaning: DMR measurements whose monitoring period ends within Federal FY2025.
relations.grounding_contract: Completeness receipt over compiled_dmr_measurement joined to period_in_fy2025 where in_fy2025 is true.
relations.construction_rule: C4: SELECT measurements linked to FY2025 periods from compiled_dmr_measurement and period_in_fy2025.

relations.name: measurement_has_ordinary_numeric_result

roles.name: measurement
roles.semantic_identity: reported measurement reference or value summary

relations.meaning: Whether a compiled DMR row carries an ordinary numeric reported value suitable for Purpose A exceedance comparison (excludes blank, NODI-only, and qualifier-only non-numeric forms).
relations.grounding_contract: Deterministic rule over compiled_dmr_measurement fields documented in derivation basis; no purpose policy embedded.
relations.construction_rule: C4: TRUE when reported_value_number is non-null and nodi_code is empty and value is not toxicity/pass-fail coded without numeric threshold linkage.

relations.name: limit_active_in_period
relations.meaning: Compiled limit value whose effective date window overlaps the monitoring period end date.
relations.grounding_contract: Date-overlap derivation from compiled_limit_value and monitoring_period with cited overlap rule.
relations.construction_rule: C4: Join on facility; test period_end_date between limit_begin_date and limit_end_date (inclusive).

relations.name: measurement_limit_candidate_pair

roles.name: measurement
roles.semantic_identity: reported measurement reference or value summary

relations.meaning: Candidate pairing of an in-scope DMR measurement with a compiled limit value sharing facility, feature, parameter, and period overlap.
relations.grounding_contract: Completeness receipt over dmr_in_fy2025_scope cross limit_active_in_period on shared keys.
relations.construction_rule: C4: Join measurement to limit_value on facility, feature, parameter; require limit_active_in_period and FY2025 scope.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: Enumerate all limit_value referents sharing facility, feature, and parameter with period-overlapping effective dates for each in-scope measurement.

relations.name: monitoring_requirement_in_fy2025

roles.name: requirement
roles.semantic_identity: requirement identification (parameter, feature, frequency, limit set, or permit condition anchor)

relations.meaning: Monitoring requirements whose schedule effective window could apply during some portion of Federal FY2025.
relations.grounding_contract: Completeness receipt over monitoring_requirement_schedule intersecting FY2025 date bounds.
relations.construction_rule: C4: Select requirements whose limit_begin_date/limit_end_date overlap the FY2025 window.

relations.name: missing_evidence_case_universe

roles.name: measurement
roles.semantic_identity: observed result form (NODI code, blank, qualifier-only, absent submission, etc.)

roles.name: requirement
roles.semantic_identity: requirement identification (parameter, feature, frequency, limit set, or permit condition anchor)

relations.meaning: In-scope FY2025 monitoring expectations paired with DMR rows that lack an ordinary numeric result, or expected submissions with no located DMR row.
relations.grounding_contract: Completeness receipt over monitoring_requirement_in_fy2025 and dmr_in_fy2025_scope filtered by measurement_has_ordinary_numeric_result = false; absent-submission cases require explicit expectation tuple.
relations.construction_rule: C4: Union of (requirement, period) with non-numeric/absent DMR in FY2025; exclude tuples already routed to Purpose A numeric exceedance path.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: For each FY2025 requirement interval, pair with matching feature-parameter-period DMR rows lacking ordinary numeric results; emit absent-submission cases only when schedule frequency implies an expected period with no DMR row.

relations.name: limit_applicability_resolution

roles.name: measurement
roles.semantic_identity: reported measurement reference or value summary

relations.meaning: Purpose A judgment establishing which enforceable numeric limit (if any) applies to a measurement tuple for its monitoring period.
relations.grounding_contract: C3 resolution packet citing compiled_limit_value rows, schedule fields, and any permit-text evidence used; unresolved tuples omit selected_limit or leave applicability_status unresolved.
relations.construction_rule: C2/C3: For each measurement_limit_candidate_pair, disambiguate by statistical base, unit, seasonal month flags, and limit-set designator; ACCEPT single applicable limit, REJECT non-applicable candidates, or UNRESOLVED when evidence underdetermines.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: One resolution attempt per measurement drawn from measurement_limit_candidate_pair universe.
relations.unresolved_judgment: Which enforceable numeric limit (if any) applies to the measurement for the monitoring period.

relations.name: limit_kind_resolution

roles.name: measurement
roles.semantic_identity: reported measurement reference or value summary

roles.name: limit_category
roles.semantic_identity: limit category (enforceable numeric vs report-only vs no numeric comparison)

relations.meaning: Purpose A classification of whether a candidate or selected limit is enforceable-numeric, report-only, or structurally non-comparable for numeric compliance.
relations.grounding_contract: C3 packet citing LIMIT_TYPE_CODE, OPTIONAL_MONITORING_FLAG, numeric threshold presence, and measurement form from world relations.
relations.construction_rule: C2/C3: Apply purpose A limit_kind policies to compiled evidence; never persist as unconditional world truth.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: Evaluate each measurement_limit_candidate_pair and each limit_applicability_resolution selected_limit.
relations.unresolved_judgment: Whether the limit regime permits enforceable numeric comparison for this measurement tuple.

relations.name: exceedance_resolution

roles.name: measurement
roles.semantic_identity: reported measurement reference or value summary

relations.meaning: Purpose A numeric comparison verdict between a reported measurement and an applicable enforceable limit under explicit unit and statistical-base alignment.
relations.grounding_contract: C3 packet citing measurement value, limit threshold, qualifier direction, unit conversion basis, and statistical-base match rationale.
relations.construction_rule: C2/C3: Compare only when limit_kind_resolution is enforceable_numeric and units/statistical bases align; otherwise emit not_applicable or unresolved.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: One comparison per measurement where limit_applicability_resolution establishes a single enforceable numeric limit.
relations.unresolved_judgment: Whether the reported numeric value exceeds the applicable enforceable limit threshold.

relations.name: monitoring_obligation_resolution

roles.name: requirement
roles.semantic_identity: requirement identification (parameter, feature, frequency, limit set, or permit condition anchor)

roles.name: applicability_context
roles.semantic_identity: applicability period or trigger context within FY2025

roles.name: condition_dependencies
roles.semantic_identity: condition dependencies evaluated (discharge occurrence, season, permit year, special study, event, etc.)

relations.meaning: Purpose B judgment whether monitoring was required, not required, or unresolved for a schedule requirement within an evaluated FY2025 context.
relations.grounding_contract: C3 packet citing schedule tuples, optional-monitoring flags, discharge/no-discharge evidence, and permit-text extracts when conditions gate applicability.
relations.construction_rule: C2/C3: Evaluate conditional activation per purpose B policies; not-required requires positive non-activation evidence, not mere missing DMR rows.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: One resolution per monitoring_requirement_in_fy2025 referent crossed with applicable FY2025 sub-intervals or trigger contexts.
relations.unresolved_judgment: Whether monitoring was required for the evaluated FY2025 period or trigger context.

relations.name: missing_evidence_resolution

roles.name: observed_form
roles.semantic_identity: observed result form (NODI code, blank, qualifier-only, absent submission, etc.)

relations.meaning: Purpose C classification of what available evidence establishes for monitoring expectations lacking an ordinary numeric DMR result.
relations.grounding_contract: C3 packet citing NODI codes, DMR presence/absence, no-discharge documentation, and cross-references to monitoring_obligation_resolution when obligation status matters.
relations.construction_rule: C2/C3: Classify evidential meaning only; never infer compliance or violation from absence alone; defer when obligation applicability itself is unresolved.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: One resolution per tuple in missing_evidence_case_universe.
relations.unresolved_judgment: What the missing or non-ordinary result establishes about the monitoring expectation.

relations.name: purpose_a_output_row

roles.name: measurement
roles.semantic_identity: reported measurement reference or value summary

roles.name: limit_category
roles.semantic_identity: limit category (enforceable numeric vs report-only vs no numeric comparison)

relations.meaning: Projected Purpose A output row assembling world facts and purpose resolutions for one measurement-limit evaluation.
relations.grounding_contract: Projection inherits grounding from constituent purpose resolutions and compiled world tuples.
relations.construction_rule: C4: Join dmr_in_fy2025_scope with limit_applicability_resolution, limit_kind_resolution, and exceedance_resolution; emit unresolved list separately.

relations.name: purpose_b_output_row

roles.name: requirement
roles.semantic_identity: requirement identification (parameter, feature, frequency, limit set, or permit condition anchor)

roles.name: applicability_context
roles.semantic_identity: applicability period or trigger context within FY2025

roles.name: condition_dependencies
roles.semantic_identity: condition dependencies evaluated (discharge occurrence, season, permit year, special study, event, etc.)

relations.meaning: Projected Purpose B output row for one evaluated monitoring requirement.
relations.grounding_contract: Projection inherits grounding from monitoring_obligation_resolution packets.
relations.construction_rule: C4: Join monitoring_requirement_in_fy2025 to monitoring_obligation_resolution; route unresolved verdicts to purpose_ir/b/output.json unresolved list.

relations.name: purpose_c_output_row

roles.name: observed_form
roles.semantic_identity: observed result form (NODI code, blank, qualifier-only, absent submission, etc.)

relations.meaning: Projected Purpose C output row for one missing-evidence or non-ordinary-result case.
relations.grounding_contract: Projection inherits grounding from missing_evidence_resolution packets.
relations.construction_rule: C4: Join missing_evidence_case_universe to missing_evidence_resolution; emit unresolved classifications to purpose_ir/c/output.json unresolved list.

limitations: Permit PDF text extraction relations are deferred; condition_anchor_text is limited to DMR_COMMENT_TEXT from structured CSV until C1 permit parsing exists.
Monthly seasonal activation for limits is partially represented via all_months_active boolean; per-month columns from permit_limits.csv are not yet modeled as separate relations.
Absent-submission detection in missing_evidence_case_universe depends on frequency-code interpretation rules not yet compiled as world facts.
No closed-world negation for unlocated limits; unresolved dispositions carry obligation to emit explicit unresolved output rather than inferring absence.
